''See also: [[Valinhall Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Valinhall]] [[Incarnation]] is a powerful entity and an extension of the [[Valinhall]] [[Territory]], which was established sixty years ago through the experiments of [[Damasca]]. This entity represents a [[Traveler]]'s power that has become uncontrolled and rampant, driven by personal grief or ambition. Incarnation{{!}}The Incarnation acts as a force of nature that seeks to transform the world into a harsh, combat-oriented environment where status is earned through battle. Its presence can physically warp the surrounding reality, causing objects to transform into different forms as the world attempts to mimic [[Valinhall]]. The first and most notable figure associated with this role is Valin{{!}}Valin, the Wanderer. As the founder of [[Valinhall]], he originally used the territory's power to fight against [[Damasca]]. While [[Incarnations]] are typically considered a manifestation of a [[Traveler]]'s power gone wrong, [[Valin]] is unique because he was the founder who became an [[Incarnation]]. The entity has been known to go on destructive rampages, such as the massacre at [[Harinfel]], and has been described as moving in a direct path toward specific targets, such as the royal palace in [[Cana]]. Although they are considered a rare and dwindling breed, there have been instances of multiple [[Incarnations]] existing or appearing over time.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This entity is a man characterized by black eyes. His physical form is wrapped in the shadows of [[chains]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Incarnation{{!}}The Incarnation is a dark, horrible, and violent being. Driven by ambition that has consumed and warped him, he serves as a planned distraction force.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Incarnation{{!}}The Incarnation possesses the power to use shadows to kidnap people. His presence is capable of transforming environments and objects, and he may be involved in calling [[black chains]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Crimson Vault}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|After escaping from his prison, the [[Valinhall]] [[Incarnation]] is located within the palace.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c9">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 14</ref> This dark and violent entity is capable of using shadows to kidnap people, and [[Alin]] suspects that [[Simon]] intends to kill him.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14" /> Consumed and warped by ambition, the incarnation will likely be challenged by those who summon The mask{{!}}the mask.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 15</ref> The being can be unleashed on [[Zakareth]] as part of a planned distraction force.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c16">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c19">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 19</ref> During the battle, the incarnation fought against [[Kai]] and was involved in the ongoing conflict.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c19" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 20</ref> Appearing as a man with black eyes and a body wrapped in the shadows of [[chains]], he was fought by [[Simon]] in an attempt to slay him.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|City of Light}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Valinhall]] [[Incarnation]] is a type of entity or power whose very presence has the ability to transform environments and objects.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c1">''City of Light'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref> Described as a scary figure, this entity was known to have given orders from behind [[Zakareth]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c10">''City of Light'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref> [[Leah's father]] once fought Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation, and it is noted that the entity may have been involved in calling [[black chains]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c7">''City of Light'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25" /> While [[Indirial]] is Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation of [[Valinhall]], [[Simon]] becomes this being upon wearing The mask{{!}}the mask.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c19">''City of Light'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c20">''City of Light'', chapter 20</ref> [[Caela]] sensed an [[Incarnation]] outside the Gate, yet [[Simon]] remains the only individual to have won a fight against the last [[Valinhall]] [[Incarnation]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref>}}
